items.problem: Startup crash whose captured stack ends at Application.Start <- Program.Main led the agent to mutate the entry point (DISABLE_XAML_GENERATED_MAIN + hand-rolled MTA Program.cs dropping [STAThread]/InitializeComWrappers), permanently breaking the app (score 0/6).
items.evidence: session-log L5200-5206 (crash with correct generated [STAThread] Main), L7815 ('try adding a custom Program.cs to override with MTA threading'); final csproj DISABLE_XAML_GENERATED_MAIN + Program.cs Main lacking [STAThread]+InitializeComWrappers.
items.root_cause: The skill's 'do not assume the entry point is the problem' note was a buried parenthetical, and the 0x8001010E table row pointed only to 'UWP API in a static initializer', so the Application.Start reporting frame misled the agent into the forbidden entry-point edits.
items.change: Promote the buried entry-point note into a prominent '🚫 Anti-pattern' block in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#startup-crashes: a throw at Application.Start/Program.Main is the reporting frame, not the cause; forbid removing [STAThread]/switching to MTA/adding DISABLE_XAML_GENERATED_MAIN/hand-rolling Program.cs. Cross-link the 0x8001010E row and SKILL.md L134 to it.
items.expected_effect: On a re-run hitting a startup crash, the agent fixes the activation path / package refs instead of editing the entry point, so it does not introduce the 0x8001010E regression.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run build-events show no DISABLE_XAML_GENERATED_MAIN added and no hand-written Program.cs created; Validate-UwpMigration Section 7 does not report a 0x8001010E 'multi-thread apartment' crash caused by an entry-point edit.

items.problem: Agent spent ~250+ turns hunting NuGet/targets/templates for where Program.Main is defined.
items.evidence: session-log L5207-7815 repeated searches; resolved only at L7755-7773 when App.g.i.cs's generated Main was located.
items.root_cause: The skill never states that WinUI 3 auto-generates Program.Main into obj/.../App.g.i.cs (gated by DISABLE_XAML_GENERATED_MAIN).
items.change: Add a one-sentence fact to the same anti-pattern block: Program.Main is auto-generated into obj/<config>/.../App.g.i.cs under '#if !DISABLE_XAML_GENERATED_MAIN'; you normally have no Program.cs — don't search for it or create one.
items.expected_effect: Agent stops spelunking for the entry point, saving a large turn budget that previously starved the actual fix.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run build-events show no multi-turn search of ~/.nuget / .targets / templates for 'Program'/'STAThread'/'EntryPoint'.

deferred_to_human: Tier 0: the underlying Accelerometer crash reproduced inside native Application.Start even with the correct generated [STAThread] Main (session-log L5200-5206), consistent with a Windows App SDK package/runtime mismatch (csproj pins Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK 2.2.0 while microsoft.windowsappsdk.winui 2.2.1 was on the restore path). If the scaffold/preset pins these versions, align them — out of scope for an in-skill prose edit.
